words.gloss: those who would drink eagerly (out of feigned love)

literal: Even if they resemble those who would drink eagerly, the friendship of those who lack good character, rather than increasing, decreasing is pleasant.
translation: Even if they appear so affectionate that they could drink you up, the friendship of those devoid of character is better off dwindling than growing.
modern: நம்மை விழுங்குவது போல் அன்பு காட்டுபவர்களாக இருந்தாலும், நற்பண்பு இல்லாதவர்களின் நட்பு வளர்வதை விடத் தேய்ந்து போவதே நல்லது.
explanation: This couplet warns us about the superficial affection of unprincipled people. The phrase 'பருகுவார் போலினும்' vividly describes those who act so intensely loving that they seem ready to 'drink you up' or consume you with affection. However, if these people lack basic moral character (பண்பிலார்), their friendship (கேண்மை) is dangerous. The poet advises that it is far better (இனிது) for such a relationship to gradually fade away (குன்றல்) rather than to grow and strengthen (பெருகலின்).
